titleByLocale.it: Internship in Risorse Umane operations team
titleByLocale.fr: Internship in Ressources Humaines operations team

descriptionByLocale.en:
We're looking for an HR Operations Intern to:

• Support the HR Operations Operations Team in daily activities in our HR and ticketing system,
• Deliver results within defined deadlines,
• Treat sensitive documents with professionalism and discretion, minimizing risk of data breaches,
• Stay on top of and ensure compliance to internal policies and processes,
• Work 5 days a week with minimum 3 days from our Krakow office;
